Frequency Once per ten minutes

Requirements You know and can cast the Ignition cantrip.

You can strike a fiendish flame with your body instead of relying on your ability to cast spells. If your next action is to cast the Ignition cantrip, you can instead deliver the cantrip with an ancestral unarmed Strike (if your target is in melee reach), or with a ranged Strike (if your target is within 30 feet). In this instance, you use the respective attack rolls instead of a spell attack roll. If you make an unarmed Strike and you succeed, you deal the damage of a melee Ignition cantrip in addition to your Strike damage. If you make a ranged Strike, you add your Strength modifier to the damage of a ranged Ignition spell.
